# Give the idea another appointment {#lesson-spacing}

Yesterday you could explain the idea. Today you have to work a little harder.
That is a reason to practice again, not evidence that yesterday was pointless.
Spacing distributes learning across separate occasions instead of doing every
attempt in one sitting. It can be combined with retrieval: attempt the answer,
check it, and revisit it in a later study session.

::: objectives
After this lesson, you can plan spaced practice (`plan-spaced-practice`) and
reuse the retrieval principle (`explain-retrieval`) in a new setting.
:::

## Work through it

Here is a hypothetical plan for learning a decision procedure. On Monday, study
a completed example and explain it without the notes. On Wednesday, try a new
case, then check your reasoning. In a subsequent session, explain why a tempting
alternative fails. These dates illustrate separate study occasions; research
does not make this exact schedule universally optimal.

Now repair this incomplete plan: “Read the chapter on Monday. On Wednesday,
____.” A useful completion includes an attempt to recall or apply the idea,
followed by checking the answer. Merely scheduling another look at the page
does not specify what you will practice.

For independent application, imagine you need the idea next month. Plan two
future opportunities to retrieve it, and describe what you will do if your
explanation is incomplete. Your plan should allow correction. It should also
fit your available time; an elaborate plan you never use has limited value.

```text
attempt -> compare with the source -> correct -> revisit later
```

## Recap

![Attempt an explanation, check it against the source, then revisit it in a later session.](assets/practice.svg)

Earlier we practiced producing an explanation. Here we distributed that practice
across occasions. Keep actual answers as evidence of progress, and keep enjoyment
or confidence as separate observations. The [research overview](#source-spacing-review)
supports spacing and retrieval broadly; this miniature example is not a study
of this particular ebook.
